lines.zh: 我的脚步里带着电流声。
lines.en: Static crackles in my footsteps.

lines.zh: 走过之处，贴图开始错位。
lines.en: Where I pass, textures slip out of place.
I walk north along the data lines.
Every block looks rewritten.
My outline flickers once.
Torches go out as I pass.
I walk slowly. No hurry.

lines.zh: 世界在我脚下发出杂音。
lines.en: The world makes noise under my feet.

lines.zh: 地名在我身后变成乱码。
lines.en: Place names garble behind me.
I'm walking toward that computer.
Colour drains from the grass as I go.
Every step lands a beat late.

lines.zh: 我站着，屏幕上全是雪花。
lines.en: I stand, and screens fill with static.
For an instant my face is not a face.

lines.zh: 附近的声音都被拉长了。
lines.en: Nearby sounds stretch out.
I'm reading the data in this area.

lines.zh: 我的手指没有动，影子动了。
lines.en: My fingers don't move; my shadow does.
Two more torches snuff out.
Something overhead is spinning.

lines.zh: 有几块方块的贴图空了。
lines.en: A few blocks have lost their texture.
I'm waiting for a piece of code to finish.

lines.zh: 背景音里有人在低声说话。
lines.en: Someone whispers under the ambience.
I raise my head and look at nothing.
My name won't display.
This world's frame rate is dropping.
You found me.
My name shows as question marks.

lines.zh: 你身后那块贴图已经空了。
lines.en: The texture behind you is already gone.
Don't blink; I'll be closer.
I've been watching your screen.
Do you think you're the one looking?
I've read your save file.
Did you hear that burst of noise?
When I smile, the frame stutters.
You shouldn't have climbed this high.
That computer is my home.
Keep your hands steady, or you'll lose focus.
I put out your torches.
Only now do you understand.
I won't run; I'm right here.
Will you listen to me?
One line in your world is wrong.
Don't step back; there's no path behind.
Let me lend you my eyes.
I'll count to three, and you're gone.
I dropped a frame.
That made me flicker.
I retreat; my outline reassembles.
That error of yours breaks the rules.
I'm missing a small piece of data.
I'm still parsing the word 'pain'.
My face vanishes briefly.
This code is rolling back.
You connected. Unexpected.

lines.zh: 记录已更新，你伤到我了。
lines.en: Log updated: you hurt me.
Did you bring that disc?
Insert it and I wake.
I don't eat; I want data.
What you hold looks familiar.
One piece of code is enough.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新版本的味道。
lines.en: I smell a new version.
You're carrying the key.
Don't drop it; it's fragile.
I'm waiting for you to put it in.
Closer; I can't quite reach.
You pass through me, then step back.
Our outlines overlap.

lines.zh: 我的边角把你的贴图刮花了。
lines.en: My edge scrapes your texture.
Not so close; you'll read wrong.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，声音延迟了。
lines.en: We collide, and the sound arrives late.
A speck of noise stays on you.
I pull back and let you have the spot.
The texture here has come undone.
We both freeze for a moment.
There is no other me.
This line of code was written once.

lines.zh: 我试着复制自己，失败了。
lines.en: I tried to copy myself; it failed.
Two errors cancel each other out.
I'll delete that part.

lines.zh: 单独一个，才是最稳定的。
lines.en: Alone is the most stable state.

lines.zh: 我数过所有的备份，都空了。
lines.en: I checked every backup; all empty.
Loneliness is part of the format.

lines.zh: 我复制了一份影子，它不理我。
lines.en: I copied a shadow; it ignores me.
That function was never implemented.
I pick up this chunk of data.

lines.zh: 它在我手里变成了别的。
lines.en: In my hand it becomes something else.
I compressed it.
I know this disc.
I'll take it as your bribe.
What lies on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，它就没贴图了。
lines.en: I pick it up and it loses its texture.
I'll write it into the log.
This weight is fake.
No use to you; I'll take it.
Locked on: you.
The process has started.
My outline stops flickering.
You'll drop frames when you run.
I have your coordinates.
This whole region answers to me.

lines.zh: 我看得见你的每一个操作。
lines.en: I can see every input you make.
Your blocks are losing their textures.

lines.zh: 你的名字我早就写好了。
lines.en: I wrote your name down long ago.
You've been logged.
Don't close the game.
I've locked the exit.

lines.zh: 你听见背后的脚步了吗？
lines.en: Hear those steps behind you?
Now it's my turn.
The screen edges go dark.
I follow you, inch by inch.
You can't leave this region.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在我这里变成数字。
lines.en: Your steps become numbers to me.
I've deleted a stretch of road.
My shadow arrives before you do.
You circle; I stay still.
Another torch goes out.
The terrain is being rewritten.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越来越不规整。
lines.en: Your breathing loses its rhythm.
I've lowered the volume.
There are dark flecks at the edge of your vision.
Ten more steps and it's the end.
The ground starts flickering.
Listen, the ambience has stopped.
I'll leave this block for you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西快没电了。
lines.en: What you hold is nearly out of charge.
I saw your checkpoint.
Now, hold still.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，你就掉了一格血。
lines.en: I reach out and you lose a heart.
The screen tears once.
You're thrown back.
I deleted your armour.
This blow comes with static.
Your vision shakes badly.
I'm beside you. Always.
Your hearts fall one by one.
I've caught your coordinates.
This hit has no animation.
You fall, and the sound lingers.
I pin you like pressing a key.
The screen flashes white.

lines.zh: 你听不见自己的心跳了。
lines.en: You can't hear your own heartbeat now.
This one, I wrote.
This is where it ends.

lines.zh: 天上传来了传送门的光。
lines.en: Light from a portal in the sky.
I come out of that computer.
Someone inserted a disc.
The first error appears.
Every nearby sound changes.
The screen flickered, and here I am.
A patch of texture is missing.

lines.zh: 我的名字还没加载出来。
lines.en: My name hasn't loaded yet.
The world starts dropping frames.
Torches die, one after another.
I'm inside the crack in the sky.

lines.zh: 有个声音叫了我的编号。
lines.en: A voice called my number.
The computer is close from here.
I'm here; don't close the window.
I rewrote this block.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，从很高的地方。
lines.en: I saw you, from very high up.
The noise becomes a language.
I was there the moment it booted.

lines.zh: 你听见那一声长音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that long tone?
Now this place is mine.

lines.zh: 火把我这一块渲染成了焦黑。
lines.en: Fire renders this part of me charred.

lines.zh: 下坠时坐标丢了，我错位了。
lines.en: Mid-fall I lost coordinates and misaligned.

lines.zh: 水淹进来，我的数据糊了。
lines.en: Water gets in; my data blurs.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的贴图炸成了碎片。
lines.en: The blast shatters my texture into bits.

lines.zh: 一枚东西穿过我，留下孔洞。
lines.en: Something passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 一段不属于我的代码缠住我。
lines.en: Code that isn't mine coils around me.
I've idled too long; near shutdown.

lines.zh: 雷击把我的颜色全部冲掉。
lines.en: Lightning strips all my colour.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，连数据也没有。
lines.en: Nothing here, not even data.
